To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: security@vertexhealth.com
Date: 2026-08-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG & final artifacts for procurement review

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the productive call yesterday — our procurement and InfoSec teams are aligned that we need the completed SIG spreadsheet and the bundle of compliance artifacts to finish a final review. Can you confirm you can provide the following by EOD Sep 3 (our legal team needs to wrap before our board meeting next week):

- Completed SIG XLS (answers filled)
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent period)
- High-level penetration test summary (executive summary is fine; full report requires NDA)
- ISO statements (ISO 27001/27701 posture statement or certificate references)
- Security deck (for our execs)

Also, if there are any outstanding questions on retention or data flow items on the SIG, flag them so we can triage with engineering. If possible, please include a short note indicating which artifacts require an NDA for full access.

Best,
Maria Ortega
Director, Procurement
Vertex Health

[external contact: +1 415 555 0168]

Subject: Re: SIG & final artifacts for procurement review

Maria — thanks for laying this out. We can meet your Sep 3 timeline. Plan below: 

- Marissa will assemble the SIG XLS and the security deck and upload to a secure drive.
- Priyom will confirm SOC 2 scope and provide the most recent Type II report PDF and the pen test executive summary.
- I'll coordinate the DocuSign NDA for the full pen test if Vertex requires it.

Quick items we flagged: the SIG question on data retention (section 7) — we mark our retention policy and point to the retention section in the SOC 2 report; if vertex wants a stricter retention commitment we should capture that as a contracting exception.

We will send the first bundle (SIG XLS + SOC2 + exec pen test summary + ISO statement + security deck) via secure share by Tue 8/31. If Vertex elects to sign the NDA, we can provide the full pen test report after that.

Action owners:
- Marissa: assemble artifacts and share drive link (by 8/31)
- Priyom: confirm SOC 2 metadata and pen test executive summary (by 8/31)
- Jonas: prepare NDA DocuSign and loop legal (as needed)

2) We would like to review the full pen test report. Please send the DocuSign NDA when it's ready and we'll turn that around quickly.

Can we also do a 15-minute call tomorrow to confirm the retention language? Alan — available between 10:00 and 11:30 PT?

Best,
